name: Ink splash
summary: Ink blot that splats out of a point with droplets and streaks, then holds still; for punchy title reveals.

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at

params.name: seed
params.note: change for a different blot shape

params.name: color
params.note: ink colour; default the style ink

author: krakujs
